content.short: Templates for popular smart contracts curated by Marcel.
content.description: A curated collection of popular smart contracts designed for developers to explore, dissect, and adapt for their own projects. The repository provides proven code you can study to brainstorm ideas, understand contract form and flow, and accelerate development efforts. Since its early days it has attracted nearly 200 developers and serves as a practical resource for both beginners and seasoned experts seeking concrete examples and reliable references to learn from and build upon.
